source.author: verg
source.text: Ergo alacris, cunctosque putans excedere palma, Aeneae stetit aute pedes, nec plura moratus tum laeva taurum cornu tenet, atque ita fatur:
source.text_original: Ergo alacris, cunctosque putans excedere palma, / Aeneae stetit aute pedes, nec plura moratus / tum laeva taurum cornu tenet, atque ita fatur: /
source.text_english: So, eager, and thinking that he outstripped them all in the prize, he stood before Aeneas’ feet, and, without further delay, then with his left hand he seized the bull by the horn and spoke thus:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, fatur et haec:
reuse.text_original: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, / obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, / fatur et haec:
reuse.text_english: Only that one, raging, stands in the way with women’s howls, as much as the Martian trumpet drowns the Idaean boxwood pipe; and she says this:
